@ plus1 in the loop: x is the last event of g before the frame, so g is 1 1 2 2 3 3 4 4
@ a when~ whose condition is an expression of its own events (== 0): it is the default of its type (false) until the first event, so the part is stopped from the start
@ a when~ that reads its own event at sample runs while the last event of the delay is 0 and holds the last event after
@ a delay with an init in the call that gives its events: the init is given at the first event
@ a delay of a delay in the call that gives its events is the g of two events before
@ a delay of the events of a call after the one it is written in is read at the last event
@ a delay of a sparse event in the argument of a call is read at the last event, in the frame of the event too
@ a delay of a sparse event in a when~: the part runs while the last output of the delay is 1, and holds its last event
@ a delay of a sparse event in the condition of a when~ and in the argument: the part runs from the first event while the output is 5
